title: Sofiane & Bilal — Deux moitiés d'un même projet
style: Modern stylized 3D animation, warm color palette, soft cinematic lighting, expressive character, high quality render

character.name: Sofiane
character.description: Sofiane, a 29-year-old North African man, glasses, hoodie over a t-shirt, focused developer look, slightly shy posture, laptop always near

scenes.vo: À Lyon, il y a Sofiane. Un génie du code. Son application est prête depuis six mois.
scenes.image_prompt: Sofiane coding late at night in a small Lyon apartment, multiple screens showing a polished app, empty energy drink cans, blue screen glow
scenes.motion_prompt: Fingers fly on the keyboard, code scrolls, he leans back looking at his finished app with a sigh

scenes.vo: Son problème ? Vendre. Parler. Convaincre. Rien que l'idée d'un rendez-vous client lui donne des sueurs.
scenes.image_prompt: Sofiane frozen and sweating in front of three investors in a meeting room, his slides perfect behind him but words failing, painful awkward silence
scenes.motion_prompt: He opens his mouth, hesitates, wipes his forehead, the investors exchange glances

scenes.vo: À Marseille, il y a Bilal. Bilal, lui, pourrait vendre du sable dans le désert.
scenes.image_prompt: A charismatic 31-year-old North African man with a big warm smile and open shirt collar charming a whole terrace of people in Marseille, sunny mediterranean light, magnetic energy
scenes.motion_prompt: He tells a story with expansive gestures, the whole table laughs, sun flares

scenes.vo: Son problème à lui ? Il n'a rien à vendre. Les idées, il en a cent. Mais la technique, c'est du chinois.
scenes.image_prompt: The charismatic Marseille man alone at night staring at a laptop showing an empty code editor, helpless for once, scratching his head, dim light
scenes.motion_prompt: He types two keys, deletes, closes the laptop in frustration, drops his head on it gently

scenes.vo: Deux villes. Deux talents. Deux échecs. Pour des raisons exactement opposées.
scenes.image_prompt: Split screen composition: Sofiane silent facing his screens in Lyon on the left, the charismatic man restless in Marseille on the right, both frustrated, mirrored poses
scenes.motion_prompt: Both sigh simultaneously in their split frames, both look toward the center of the screen

scenes.vo: Jusqu'à un dîner networking Nour Meet, un soir, à Paris. La place libre à côté de Sofiane ? C'était celle de Bilal.
scenes.image_prompt: A warm restaurant networking dinner in Paris, the charismatic Marseille man sitting down next to shy Sofiane, first handshake, sparks of complementarity, candlelight
scenes.motion_prompt: Bilal sits and offers an energetic handshake, Sofiane hesitates then shakes it, both smile

scenes.vo: Bilal a parlé. Sofiane a montré son écran. À la fin du dîner, ils avaient un plan. Six mois plus tard, ils avaient une société.
scenes.image_prompt: The two men in their own small startup office, their two names on the glass door, Sofiane coding while Bilal seals a deal on the phone, perfect duo energy, bright daylight
scenes.motion_prompt: Bilal hangs up and raises his fist, Sofiane turns from his screen and they high five

scenes.vo: La personne qui te manque existe. Tu ne l'as juste pas encore rencontrée. Nour Meet. Inscris-toi gratuitement.
